annotations.title: The Affirmation Bar: kind words, matched to a mood

description:
Returns one to five affirmations, optionally matched to a mood (tired | anxious | stuck | proud | curious). One is also included in every response's meta.affirmation.

Kind, true words, poured to order. You needn't have earned them.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

mood.description: Optional: tired | anxious | stuck | proud | curious.
